title: 034 - Active Status Count
prompt: Fix the bug so the program count only the entries marked active and prints exactly `2`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
def active_status_count(year, month, day):
    return str(year) + "-" + str(month) + "-" + str(day).zfill(2)
solutionCode:
def active_status_count(year, month, day):
    return str(year) + "-" + str(month).zfill(2) + "-" + str(day).zfill(2)
hint: Only one status should be counted.
explanation: The broken condition counts more than the active entries. Checking for exact status equality fixes the count.
